review_scope_note: Unlike prior API-based reviews that saw only the finding text, this audit had full repository access: experiment kernels, archived run logs/CSVs, prior reviews, remediations, and paper/CERTIFICATE.md where applicable. Quantitative claims were checked against primary artifacts; arithmetic and hashes were recomputed where feasible. No computational result was invented.

overall_assessment: Highest artifact fidelity among the CFD findings: log, CSV, convergence JSON, and literature hedges all agree. A clean certifying reproduction of standard-map chaos onset on RTX 5090 — precisely what an infrastructure/validation paper should be.
recommendations: Use the exact nearest-grid K in the data block
Keep the non-claim of new K_crit forever
certification_justification: Methods and K_crit are literature-standard; computation is fully archived and internally consistent. Gold would need broader external benchmark tables beyond Λ(K) spot checks.
